metadata.text: To succeed in a tech career, focus on building strong fundamentals in data structures, algorithms, and system design. Participate in open-source projects and contribute to communities.

Interview Preparation Questions:
- "Tell me about yourself" – Prepare a concise introduction covering education, projects, and career goals.
- "What are your strengths and weaknesses?" – Focus on technical strengths (Python, ML, React) and your learning mindset.
- "Describe a challenging project and how you solved problems" – Refer to hackathons, college events, or technical projects.
- "Why are you interested in this role/company?" – Mention specific alignment with your skills and long-term goals.
- "How do you keep your technical skills updated?" – Talk about online courses, events, and ongoing learning.
- Technical exercises – Practice Python coding, SQL queries, and common algorithms/DS questions.
- For ML/Data Science – Prepare for basic EDA, regression/classification questions, and simple model evaluation.

Job Application Tips:
- Tailor your resume for each role, highlighting relevant skills and experience.
- Use action verbs and quantifiable achievements wherever possible.
- Showcase project work, hackathon participation, and any open-source contributions.
- Connect with recruiters on LinkedIn, join relevant career groups, and actively seek referrals.
- For freshers, mention internships, college events, leadership roles, and technical certifications.
- Personalize your cover letter, addressing company values and role expectations.
- Always follow up on applications with a polite email or LinkedIn message.
Data science is a multidisciplinary field that uses statistics, programming, and domain knowledge to extract insights from data.
